mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% signals tightening, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and UNRATE (labor) indicates strong economic growth and low unemployment, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 5% and UNRATE falls < 0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in such interactions are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4% signals labor market strength, reducing risk premiums and attracting capital to equities, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consistent monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor) reflects robust job creation, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, hence positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high CPIAUCSL (inflation) and INDPRO (supply) suggests robust demand and production, offsetting inflationary pressures, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3% and INDPRO > 95.4 in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-month window, or 5-day returns in such combinations are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and FEDFUNDS above 1.5% may paradoxically boost equity valuations due to reduced growth expectations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in such regimes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in HOUST (demand) and RSAFS (demand) indicates robust industrial activity and consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and investor confidence, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 10% and RSAFS rises > 5% in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in such interactions are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
